description: Validate a probe: ungapped k-mismatch site scan over references (given strand, or with both_strands also the probe's reverse complement; sites judged by the Kane et al. 2000 criteria — > 1 such site is an issue; 1/N uniqueness score and the 3-mismatch radius are library conventions), Primer3 ntthal self-dimer/hairpin screen at the stated reaction conditions (ACGT probes <= thermodynamic_screen_max_length nt, default 60 = THAL_MAX_ALIGN, opt-in up to 10000; otherwise Primer3 alignment-mode self_any/self_end + inverted-repeat hairpin fallback, the latter reported as a warning that does not decide isValid), optional Kane et al. (2000) cross-hybridization criteria (identity > 75 % or > 15 contiguous identical nt) against non-targets.

reference_sequences.description: Reference sequences to scan for off-target hits.

max_mismatches.description: Search radius of the ungapped reference scan: maximum mismatches per site (default 3, a library convention; a found site is an issue only when it meets the Kane criteria — pass ceil(L/4) - 1 to reach every site above 75 % identity).

self_complementarity_threshold.description: Legacy fold-back-fraction limit (default 0.3); kept for compatibility, no longer used by the screen (the fallback self-dimer limit is Primer3's PRIMER_INTERNAL_MAX_SELF_ANY/_END = 12).

non_target_sequences.description: Optional known non-target sequences for the Kane et al. (2000) cross-hybridization criteria (both strands).

max_non_target_identity.description: Kane identity threshold in [0,1]; a reference site or non-target strand with identity strictly above it is flagged (default 0.75).

max_contiguous_match.description: Kane contiguous-identity threshold in nt; a reference site or non-target strand with a longer identical stretch is flagged (default 15).

max_duplex_tm.description: Optional OligoArray-style threshold (°C): a non-target site whose ntthal duplex Tm with the probe is above it is flagged (default none).

monovalent_mm.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_SALT_MONOVALENT: monovalent cation concentration in mM (> 0) for the ntthal screen and the non-target duplex Tm (default 50).

divalent_mm.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_SALT_DIVALENT: Mg²⁺ concentration in mM (>= 0; default 0).

dntp_mm.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_DNTP_CONC: dNTP concentration in mM (>= 0; default 0).

dna_conc_nm.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_DNA_CONC: probe (oligo) concentration in nM (> 0; default 50).

thermodynamic_screen.description: true (default) = Primer3 ntthal self-dimer / 3' self-dimer / hairpin Tm screen for A/C/G/T probes <= thermodynamic_screen_max_length nt (default 60) (PRIMER_THERMODYNAMIC_OLIGO_ALIGNMENT=1); false = the fallback screens for every probe (Primer3 alignment-mode self_any / self_end + the sequence-only stem-loop screen of hairpin_potential: an exactly complementary stem >= 4 bp closing a loop >= 3 nt).

max_structure_tm.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_MAX_SELF_ANY_TH = _SELF_END_TH = _HAIRPIN_TH: maximum ntthal self-dimer / 3' self-dimer / hairpin Tm in °C of the thermodynamic screen (default 47).

max_self_any.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_MAX_SELF_ANY: maximum Primer3 alignment-mode self_any of the fallback screen (default 12).

max_self_end.description: PRIMER_INTERNAL_MAX_SELF_END: maximum Primer3 alignment-mode self_end of the fallback screen (default 12).

thermodynamic_screen_max_length.description: THAL_MAX_ALIGN of ntthal (ProbeParameters.ThermodynamicScreenMaxLength): longest A/C/G/T probe given the thermodynamic self-structure screen, and the length limit of the non-target duplex Tm (computed when the probe or the site is at most this long). Default 60 = Primer3; opt-in 61..10000 = thal.c compiled with -DTHAL_MAX_ALIGN (cost grows as n^2).

both_strands.description: true = also scan the reference sequences for the probe's reverse complement (the probe's sites on the other strand of a double-stranded reference, as blastn -strand both); a position hit in both orientations (reverse-palindromic probe or site) counts once. Default false = the given strand only.

specificityScore.description: Library uniqueness score 1/N over the N ungapped sites (0 for none); a library convention, reported only (not used by isValid).

hasSecondaryStructure.description: ntthal hairpin Tm > max_structure_tm (an issue), or the fallback stem-loop screen (a warning only, not deciding isValid).

selfAny.description: Primer3 alignment-mode internal-oligo self_any (dpal LOCAL); fallback self-dimer criterion (> 12).

crossHybridizingHits.description: Ungapped reference sites meeting a Kane criterion (identity (L - mismatches)/L > max_non_target_identity or > max_contiguous_match contiguous identical nt); > 1 is an issue.

warnings.description: Reported findings that do not decide isValid: the fallback stem-loop flag 'Potential secondary structure formation' (stem >= 4 bp, library convention; audit round 5, A5-5).

errors.message: Non-target identity threshold must be in [0, 1]
Illegal value for salt or DNA concentration (Primer3: PRIMER_SALT_MONOVALENT and PRIMER_DNA_CONC must be > 0)
Illegal value for divalent salt or dNTP concentration (Primer3: PRIMER_SALT_DIVALENT and PRIMER_DNTP_CONC must be ≥ 0)
